source: Production, read-only, 2026-11-05: thirty withheld notices (ten per parser outcome, ordered by md5 of the ASX URL). Documents fetched from ASX at two-second intervals with a browser user agent; text is the first four pages' text layer as the reader sees it (document_text).
reading_status_note: Each entry's reading is made by a person from the document: the PDF fetched from the ASX terms page (its pdfURL link), read from the text layer or, for a scan, from the page images. A reading is quoted verbatim from text_file or, for a scan, from the page images. An entry with no reading is withheld_expected with its reason. On 2026-11-05 the five scans over 300 KB (PDN, D3E, IPC, MDX, DBF) were read this way. PDN and DBF keep their extracted text in text_file; the three scans without a text layer keep no file. Scans are classified by the first page's text layer, as the extractor classifies them. Entries without reading_status are read.
